extras: Formatting is stored using standard HTML5 span tags. Formatting may display raw tags in plain text editors that do not support HTML rendering.
intentEvidence: Inkwell stores all inline formatting as standard HTML <span> tags directly in your Markdown notes, keeping your notes readable and styled everywhere.
problem: Standard Markdown syntax lacks support for rich inline styling such as text color, custom font families, and specific font sizes, leading to limited visual presentation.
summary: A visual formatting tool that applies rich inline styling, including color, font size, and custom fonts, using standard HTML spans within Markdown notes.
